summary: Batch B, family B9 (`path_index_graph` / `path_tree`): the four helpers whose body is `is_tree [set: T] /\ Delta T <= 2` (X126, X189 and X95 `*_path_index_graph`, X105 `x105_path_tree`) now unfold to `GTBase.path_trees.path_tree T`, convertible. The canonical lives in the new focused module base/theories/path_trees.v, which imports GTBase.base (the owner of `Delta`) and is not re-exported, so no base/walks_paths cycle arises; each of the four conjecture files gains one `From GTBase Require Import path_trees.` line. Under the actual upstream definitions (`is_tree S := is_forest S /\ connected S`) the EMPTY graph `'K_0` is a path tree, as are `'K_1` and `'K_2`; the triangle `'K_3` is not (not a forest) and the claw `'K_1,3` is not (a vertex of degree 3), all proved in path_trees.v and used by the public client. No nonemptiness or size premise is added.

Four rows, three intermediates, all frozen with this family's helpers only: X126's pathwidth predicate and Dujmovic et al.'s Thue-choosability row; X189's spaghetti/path decomposition width and its row, the documented KNOWN-UNFAITHFUL encoding (blocked leg), kept verbatim; X105's tree inducibility row, which uses the helper negatively; X95's pathwidth predicate (over X27's unchanged tree decompositions) and its row. Tree-decomposition axioms, bag sizes, widths, colouring, inducibility and connectivity guards are unchanged.

History. The only earlier snapshot reaching these rows is B6's `Chromatic.migration.simple_path.X126Legacy.dujmovic_thue_choice_number_pathwidth_statement`, which froze the Thue chain and still calls the live `x126_pathwidth_at_most`; it is unchanged. `X126Original` composes B6's frozen `thue_choosable` with this family's frozen pathwidth, the complete pre-B6, pre-B9 row (`original-statement`). This family's per-row X126 copy is listed in B6's report.

Kernel evidence, independent of this textual report: `Print All Dependencies` of every frozen statement and of X126Original contains no live helper or chain of this family and not `path_tree`; X126Original reaches no live B6 helper and not `seq_simple_path`; each live statement reaches `path_tree` and its alias (/srv/graph-theory-rocq/coordination/evidence/B9-path_tree/print_all_dependencies_summary.txt).
No statement text, doc block, manifest row or leg state changes (checked below).
